turns.replyText:
Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes, it is handled differently.

1. Damaged plants
Live plants are not returnable. If something arrives damaged or you have concerns about the plant’s condition:

You contact us (ideally within 3 business days).
We ask for details and photos so our garden advisors can review what you received.
They then decide on next steps under our guarantees (for example, roses have a one-year conditional warranty, perennials 90 days, bulbs a failure-to-bloom guarantee).

So for damaged plants, you keep the plant; our team evaluates the situation and then guides you from there. There is no “send it back and refund” process like a typical retail return.

2. Normal returns (non-plant items)
For most non-plant items (like tools or hard goods):

You can return unused items that don’t meet your expectations within 30 days of delivery.
Items must be new and unopened, and you cover return shipping.
Approved refunds go back to your original payment method.

Some exceptions:

Custom-engraved garden markers are not returnable unless there is an issue with the engraving.
Fertilizers, soil amendments, beneficial insects, and plant treatments are final sale.

If you tell me what item was damaged (plant vs tool/supply), I can walk you through exactly what applies in your case.
